title: LoRA on a Budget: Function-Aware Post-Hoc Compression for Adapter Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2610.36386v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a key mechanism for efficiently specializing foundation models into many task- and user-specific variants. Serving many LoRA adapters under a shared resource budget turns post-hoc compression into a two-level allocation problem: rank must be distributed across layers within each adapter and across adapters within the fleet. Although trained LoRAs contain substantial spectral redundancy, spectral reconstruction alone does not determine how much compression an adapter can functionally tolerate. We formulate fleet compression through a functional rank-distortion frontier for each adapter, followed by fleet-level minimax allocation under a shared rank budget. Given exact frontiers, this decomposition is equivalent to joint optimization over all layer ranks. We introduce Functional Rank Allocation (FRA), an unlabeled method for constructing practical frontiers. FRA measures isolated module truncations end

translated_title: 预算受限下的LoRA：面向适配器集群的功能感知事后压缩
translated_abstract: 低秩适应（LoRA）已成为将基础模型高效专化为众多任务特定与用户特定变体的关键机制。在共享资源预算下服务大量LoRA适配器，使得事后压缩成为一个两级分配问题：秩需要在每个适配器内部的各层之间、以及整个适配器集群内的各适配器之间进行分配。尽管训练好的LoRA包含大量的谱冗余，但仅凭谱重构并不能确定一个适配器在功能上能够容忍多大程度的压缩。我们通过为每个适配器构建功能性的秩-失真前沿（rank-distortion frontier），并在共享秩预算下进行集群级的极小极大分配，来表述集群压缩问题。在给定精确前沿的情况下，这种分解等价于对所有层秩的联合优化。我们提出了功能秩分配（Functional Rank Allocation，FRA），这是一种无需标注的实用前沿构建方法。FRA通过测量孤立模块截断的端……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出功能秩分配（FRA）方法，通过为每个LoRA适配器构建功能秩-失真前沿，并在共享秩预算下进行集群级极小极大分配，从而解决多适配器事后压缩中的两级秩分配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Functional Rank Allocation (FRA), an unlabeled method that constructs functional rank-distortion frontiers for each LoRA adapter and performs fleet-level minimax allocation under a shared rank budget, solving the two-level post-hoc compression problem for adapter fleets.
